source_claim: After the red opening, the 64 other words of LP2-54–55 can occupy an 8-by-8 grid. The source also suggests a labyrinth path, without fixing one.
selection: Use the shared archived word-token segmentation; retain tokens starting on LP2-54 or 55; remove the first two tokens corresponding to the documented one-rune-plus-eight red opening.
arrangement: Remaining words in original order, eight columns, no changes to cross-page words.
route_control: Enumerate eight corner/direction variants of a simple inward orthogonal spiral, without scoring plaintext or choosing a preferred route.
